tei:div.tei:p: rtsom pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/

chos rje kun mkhyen dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan ni/ 'khrungs yul mnga' ris dol po pan tshang ka yo ri'i grong khyer du yab ye shes dbang phyug dang*/ yum lha mo tshul khrims rgyan gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 1292chu pho 'brug la sku bltams/ mkhan po tshul khrims snying po sogs las dge tshul gyi sdom pa blangs nas mtshan shes rab rgyal mtshan btags shing ka ri kā dang gzhung 'grel sogs gsan/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs bla ma sum cu lhag las phreng ba skor gsum dang*/ phar tshad mngon gsum dang*/ spyod 'jug/ byams chos sde lnga/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung che chung dpag tu med pa dang*/ dbang sogs mang du gsan/ dbus gtsang gi chos sde phal cher du grwa skor la phebs pas/ mkhyen rab kyi rtsal dang*/ rig pa'i rnam 'gyur bzang zhing*/ sher phyin 'bum pa sogs gzhung che chung gang la yang thogs pa med par mkhyen pa rgyas pas/ thams cad kyis kyang kun mkhyen rang du 'dug ces bsngags pas/ kun mkhyen gyi mtshan de dus nas kyang thogs/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa las bsnyen rdzogs zhus shing*/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa ma lus pa gsan/ dgung lo so gcig pa spyi lo 1322la jo nang du phebs/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho las dus 'khor sogs kyi dbang dang*/ sbyor drug dang*/ gdams pa mang du gsan/ de nas bla ma'i bka' nan chen pos dgung lo so lnga pa spyi lo 1326la rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ mkhas btsun chen pos/ lo gnyis su nye bar nyin mtshan med par dbang lung khrid bshad pa sogs/ bla ma nyid la mnga' ba'i chos thams cad bstsal/ mdor na skyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang*/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho las chos gsan pa ni mtha' yas te/ ming tsam 'dzin pa yang dka'o/ /dam pa khong gi mdzad rjes gtso bo ni/ jo nang sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo bzhengs pa dang*/ ri chos nges don rgya mtsho sogs rang bzhed rtsal du bton nas rgyas par gsungs/

rang gi slob ma lo tsā rnam gnyis la bka' gnang nas de gnyis kyis dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'gyur bcos pa dang*/ 'gyur de la gzhi mdzad nas kun mkhyen chen pos rgyud 'grel chen mo'i bsdus don dang mchan bu yang mdzad/ ri chos nges don rgya mtsho dang bka' bsdu bzhi pa la sogs pa'i gzhan stong ston pa'i bstan bcos sogs mang du brtsams/ mdor na kun mkhyen mchog gis sku tshe hril por bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs chen mdzad nas gdul bya mang po smin grol gyi lam la bkod do/ /dgung lo bdun cu pa spyi lo 1361lcags mo glang gi lo la gshegs/ de la slob ma yang lo tsā rnam gnyis dang*/ phyogs rgyal ba/ nya dbon pa sogs bu chen bcu gsum gyis mtshon pa'i mkhas grub mang du byung ngo*// // dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas dpal ldan rgya mtshos/ rtsom pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ rtsom pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 3--PAGE 1-
